definitions.pixel_representation: OpenCV uint8 BGR, unresized; original dimensions; PNG IMREAD_COLOR
definitions.pixel_hash: SHA256(str((shape,dtype.str)).encode + NUL + C-order image bytes); accepted matches also array_equal
definitions.mae: mean(abs(AVI-PNG)) across all original-resolution pixels and BGR channels; intensity units 0..255
definitions.psnr_db: 10*log10(255^2/MSE); null for exact pairs (infinity) or incompatible dimensions
definitions.metric_distributions: NumPy linear quantiles; only comparable pairs; same_dimensions/exact disambiguate null PSNR
definitions.local_search: Unresolved AVI frames: ordinal +/- 3, plus offsets of exact anchors within 3 AVI frames. Unmapped PNGs: bounded ordinal/boundary and nearby exact-anchor comparisons too. All candidates recorded; no threshold and no nearest-match acceptance
definitions.accepted_image_mapping: full equal-length ordinal pixel equality, else unique exact pixel identities with strictly monotonic PNG ordinals; crossed/duplicate identities remain unresolved
definitions.accepted_annotation_identity: unique exact basename only; same numeric token with different suffix is an unresolved candidate
definitions.filename_index: entire final digit group of stem, preserving any subject digits; not assumed zero/one based
definitions.png_ordinal_index: zero-based position in numeric-token/name ordering, separately recorded
definitions.stage2_frame_index: sequential AVI read ordinal, zero-based; round(i*1000/source_fps) milliseconds
definitions.annotation_sequence: ordered original TXT only; observed-row transitions, no imputation across filename gaps; ambiguous order/invalid rows suppress transitions
definitions.bbox: one class/cx/cy/w/h row; finite; class literal 0/1; centers [0,1], sizes (0,1]; edge overhang reported separately, never repaired
definitions.row_accounting: every AVI frame once; every PNG not accepted onto AVI once; every orphan TXT once; schema table contains every TXT
definitions.limitations: OpenCV read termination cannot distinguish EOF from decoder failure; count agreement checked against Stage 2. No pose arrays read. Local V5 download identity not independently authenticated.
